\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{شطرنج} (shatranj)}{شطرنج (shatranj)}]{\fa{شطرنج} (shatranj) — chess}

\label{lesson:FA-C280-shatranj}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a tulip, then the Persian for jasmine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{شطرنج}}
\textbf{\fa{شطرنج}} — \emph{shatranj} — \textquotedblleft{}chess\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{shatranj} is borrowed from Arabic \emph{šaṭranj}, which goes back to Middle Persian \emph{čatrang}, and that to Sanskrit \emph{caturaṅga}, the \textquotedblleft{}four-limbed\textquotedblright{} army (EtymDB). Persian took its own word back in Arabic dress.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shatranj}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shatranj}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{shatranj}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a tulip, then the Persian for jasmine, then say \emph{shatranj} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{کوهنوردی} (kuhnavardi)}{کوهنوردی (kuhnavardi)}]{\fa{کوهنوردی} (kuhnavardi) — mountain climbing}

\label{lesson:FA-C280-kuhnavardi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for jasmine, then the Persian for chess.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{کوهنوردی}}
\textbf{\fa{کوهنوردی}} — \emph{kuhnavardi} — \textquotedblleft{}mountain climbing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{kuhnavardi} is \emph{kuh}, \textquotedblleft{}mountain\textquotedblright{} (Middle Persian \emph{kōf}, EtymDB), with \emph{navard}, \textquotedblleft{}roaming\textquotedblright{} (from \emph{navardidan}), and \emph{-i}: mountain-roaming. All are native Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{نقاشی}}
\textbf{\fa{نقاشی}} — \emph{naqqâshi} — \textquotedblleft{}painting\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}

\end{cousinweb}
